note: Single source of truth for this repo's Warren constants so agents/humans never re-query the API. FILL IN projectId after adding the repo to Warren (run `bash scripts/wr-projects.sh` once and copy the id here). The token auto-loads via scripts/wr-env.sh — never export it by hand. warren-guard.js surfaces these into context at SessionStart; wr-env.sh exports projectId/baseUrl to the shell. Optionally also pin them in .claude/settings.local.json env.
